Hi Anjali — great to meet you on the call.

Short answer: if Acme Biotech is a US entity (incorporated in the US), we need a completed W-9 with EIN. If you are a non-US entity, we require a W-8BEN-E. Either way, we ask for a signed, dated form plus a short vendor onboarding form so Finance has the remittance details and banking preferences.

Next steps I can help with:
1) Please complete and return one of the following: a) signed PDF W-9 (if US) OR b) signed W-8BEN-E (if non-US).
2) Complete our Vendor Onboarding Form (one-page) so we have ACH/wire instructions and tax classification. I have attached the form here: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf.
3) Once Finance confirms the tax ID and banking, Procurement will create a PO. Typical timeline is 2–3 business days after finance verification.

For DocuSign: we can send the onboarding form and W-9 via DocuSign if that's easier — send me the preferred email address and I'll route it.

Invoice header guidance: please put the PO number on the first line of the invoice (we'll supply the PO once the vendor is set up). Payment terms for new vendors are usually Net30, unless otherwise negotiated.

Let me know if you want me to initiate DocuSign or if you'll attach the signed W-9 here.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
